brief:
The director of the Ibrahimi Mosque in Hebron, Motaz Abu Sneineh, called on citizens to attend the mosque tomorrow, Tuesday, to commemorate the Prophet's birthday, Shehab Wire reported. The observance will include events held inside the mosque.

The call comes as Palestinians mark the religious occasion, which celebrates the birth of the Prophet Muhammad. Abu Sneineh urged community members to participate in the commemorative activities scheduled at the historic shrine in the West Bank city.
